method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Warm the wholemeal flatbread in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 30–60 seconds on each side, until flexible. Keep it covered on a clean plate.
Mix the measured burger relish in a clean small bowl. Keep this finishing sauce separate from the uncooked filling.

Check the salmon fillet for pin bones and pat it dry. Keep it as a fillet for cooking. After handling raw salmon fillet, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the salmon over a medium heat for about 4–5 minutes on the first side and 3–4 minutes on the other; start skin-side down if it has skin. Turn with a wide spatula. Check the thickest part: the fish should be opaque through the centre and separate readily into flakes. Keep cooking if the centre is translucent.
Put the lettuce and tomato on the warm flatbread. Add large flakes of the cooked salmon and the cold finishing sauce, fold the bread around the filling and serve immediately.

notes: Large opaque cooked salmon flakes, shredded lettuce, tomato slices and cold relish fill one plain folded wholemeal flatbread, matching the final flaking method.
